data.name: Sharvanaa
data.gender_notes: Sharvanaa is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is the embodiment of wealth and prosperity, derived from the name Sharva, meaning wealth, and the suffix -naa, meaning Goddess. The name Sharvanaa carries the meaning “Goddess of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvanaa usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a girl symbolizing wealth, prosperity, and abundance in all areas of life. It is believed that the name Sharvanaa carries the blessings of the Goddess Lakshmi.
data.etymology: Sharvanaa belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvanaa total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sharvanaa holds great significance in Indian culture, evoking images of wealth, prosperity, and material abundance. It is a tribute to the goddess Lakshmi, who is traditionally depictedheld in Hindu iconography as an abundant feminine goddess seated on a lotus, holding a golden lotus, a commanding posture and four hands representing giving, guarding, bestowing and receiving, all symbolizing wealth and prosperity. In social context, the name Sharvanaa is often given to girls, wishing them a life filled with happiness, wealth, and prosperity.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu philosophy, the name Sharvanaa holds deeper spiritual meaning beyond material abundance. It invokes the divine power of Shakti, the cosmic creative energy that underlies all beings and all things. Sharvanaa represents the Being that bestows and guides us on our spiritual journey to eventual enlightenment. The goddess Lakshmi, also known as the goddess of Fortune, is not merely a deity associated with material wealth but also with spiritual wealth, in the form of inner peace, happiness, wisdom, and compassion. The name Sharvanaa is a reminder of the interconnectedness of all forms of wealth - material and spiritual - and the ultimate goal of spiritual enlightenment that leads to true, lasting happiness and wealth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sharvanaa: The radiant one, bathed in the grace of Saraswati, Goddess of knowledge and wisdom. Her name signifies the illumination of the mind, enabling the pursuit of knowledge and spiritual growth.
